tagline: File the right eSIM for the route you're actually flying.

layout_archetype.why: Travel data deserves breathing room. Magazine layouts balance data density with human readability.

navigation_model.why: 2,000 pages across regions → countries → plans need cluster hierarchy; partners deep-link into hubs.

visual_language.why: Travel readers want trust and warmth, not brutalist data dumps. Serif headlines feel like a Condé Nast feature.

type_pairing.why: Lora gives editorial elegance to headlines; Inter is the most legible sans for long-form reading at small sizes.

imagery_strategy.photo_style: Documentary wayfinding — departure boards, border gates, rail platforms, ferry piers, signage. Never faces.
imagery_strategy.treatment: Warm cream overlay, soft shadows, rounded corners (12px). Photos feel like travel journal pages.
imagery_strategy.svg_system: Generated SVG plan-docket cards where a photo would be generic.
